chords._schema: strings ordered low E (6) to high e (1). frets: null = muted/not played, 0 = open. fingers: 0 = open, 1 = index, 2 = middle, 3 = ring, 4 = pinky, null = muted.

exercises.name: Play the capstone

params.cue: full pass, start to finish, even if slow

exercises.coaching: Your capstone: G-D-Em-C-Am-C, all the way through, start to finish. Slow is fine. Finishing a whole song is the win — that is your first "performance."

exercises.name: 10-minute daily routine

routine: 3 min one change drill (beat last week)
params.cue: same shape every day builds the habit

exercises.coaching: Ten minutes, same shape daily: tune and warm up, one change drill, your capstone song, one new chart. Short, repeatable, and it compounds.

exercises.name: 2-week plan

plan: Week 1: lock the capstone at 80 bpm
Week 2: add one new minor progression
Then: intermediate path (barre chords, key changes)
params.cue: write it down, one small target at a time

exercises.coaching: Two weeks: week one, lock the capstone at 80 bpm; week two, add a minor progression. Then the intermediate path — barre chords and key changes. One small target at a time.

avatar_coaching_copy.ex2_intro: Ten minutes daily: warm up, one change drill, your capstone, one new chart. Same shape every day. That repetition is the habit that keeps you playing.
avatar_coaching_copy.ex3_intro: Two weeks: lock the capstone at 80 bpm, then add a minor progression. After that, intermediate — barre chords and key changes. Small targets, steady progress.
